comment: Per-semantic quality gates (spec §10). Calibrated 2026-08-06 on the full validated catalog's measured envelope (+ margin): the approved content defines the baseline, and the gates catch FUTURE regressions (a new master or toolchain drift producing worse results than anything current). Note: normal-map worst-case angular error (~15.7°) is identical across all three formats, i.e. source-driven (noisy/denormalized masters), not codec-driven — tracked as a source-cleanup follow-up, not a codec gate. Baseline codecs (etc2) get envelope thresholds: their quality ceiling is hardware physics, and no ladder escape exists on baseline devices.

ladder.comment: format_overrides proposals on failure. android-etc2 has NO ladder: ETC2/EAC is the baseline hardware ceiling — an escape to ASTC would break baseline devices.
